data.body: Operator clarification after the approved foundation changes landed. Retain the writing rules in `docs/documentation-policy.md` as authoring guidance. The rejection applies to mechanical prose or character enforcement that can produce false positives. It does not reject the writing rules. Current `origin/main` commit `e22e714c127e02826974cf17ded1fe2c9e2a8ae8` satisfies this boundary. The policy states that the rules do not define a deterministic validator or gate contract. The structural checker section states that punctuation, diction, tone, audience, ownership, and other writing guidance are not mechanically analyzed.
